info.name: Polymath API Service CANBus systemd API

items.docs:
Reverse proxy for Polymath systemd API requests. Please refer to the API documentation for details on available endpoints.

Forwards all requests under /v2/systemd/* to the systemd API service
at POLYMATH_SYSTEMD_API_IP:POLYMATH_SYSTEMD_API_PORT.

E.g. to list user services, send a GET request to: `/v2/systemd/list/user`
